title: recipe/assign-picker - assign one person from a small fixed set
problem: The sanctioned shape for assigning one person from a small fixed set (labelled native select + assign action + named feedback) is not described anywhere; agents composed it blind and could not cite it.
evidence: 4 independent runs converged on the same shape (native select + submit) under fallback/native-control (G-01)
c1 prop recipe/entity-picker and c3 prop recipe/assign-picker both requested a sanctioned composition
why_insufficient: A fallback + free-form composition leaves the need uncitable; the recipe formalises the recurring arrangement without adding any new visual language.

curation_recipe.title: Assign one person from a small fixed set
curation_recipe.summary: A labelled single-select (native select) beside one assign action; the outcome announces the new assignee by name.
needs: assign a reviewer to a request
assign an owner to a record
choose one reviewer from a fixed list
pick a person from a small fixed list
single select from a fixed set of options
choose an assignee for a record
constraints: native select for small fixed sets; component/cb only when the set is large or needs filtering
the control is always labelled and the submit announces the new value by name

evidence.quote: Fallback/local solution used: fallback/native-control in all four runs - a token-conformant native <select> + submit button

compatibility: Additive; no semantics changed; does not affect component/cb queries.
validation: all ingredients resolve within the pack
convergence: the 8 G-01 phrasings -> recipe/assign-picker; the c2/c3/c4 exact wordings must stop mis-routing to pattern/detail
non-regression: combobox -> component/cb, date picker -> component/dp
migration: The c1-c4 local <select> implementations become direct citations of this recipe; no markup change needed.
